in_scope: execution layer: state transition, account balances and total supply accounting
transaction processing: value transfer, gas prepayment, refund and fee burn
account lifecycle: creation, SELFDESTRUCT, empty-account and storage semantics
withdrawal processing (execution-layer credit of consensus-layer withdrawals)
state persistence: storage trie writes, default-value deletion, journalling and rollback
out_of_scope: liveness / performance degradation without accounting impact
x_note: Sample execution-client scope for the EthTotal (eth-total-supply-safety) track — the counterpart of bug_bounty_scope.sample.json, which is consensus-client shaped for the gasper track. The real BUG_BOUNTY_SCOPE.json comes from the speca run; this fixture exists so emit-01e and the tests can run without one.
